skills.name: scan-site
skills.description: Scan a website for AI agent readiness. Use when you need to check whether a site supports agent protocols (MCP, llms.txt, robots.txt, etc.) and get fix instructions for failing checks.

skills.name: robots-txt
skills.description: Implement a valid robots.txt with crawl rules per RFC 9309.

skills.name: ai-rules
skills.description: Add AI bot User-agent rules to robots.txt for search and training crawlers like OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, GPTBot and ClaudeBot.

skills.name: content-signals
skills.description: Declare AI content usage preferences with Content Signals in robots.txt.

skills.name: sitemap
skills.description: Publish a sitemap.xml listing canonical URLs per the Sitemaps protocol.

skills.name: llms-txt
skills.description: Publish an LLM-friendly overview at /llms.txt per llmstxt.org.

skills.name: llms-full-txt
skills.description: Publish expanded LLM content at /llms-full.txt per llmstxt.org.

skills.name: markdown-negotiation
skills.description: Support Accept: text/markdown content negotiation for machine-readable content.

skills.name: web-bot-auth
skills.description: Publish Web Bot Auth metadata so your site can identify bot requests it sends.

skills.name: mcp-server-card
skills.description: Publish an MCP Server Card at /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json for agent discovery.

skills.name: a2a-agent-card
skills.description: Publish an A2A Agent Card at /.well-known/agent-card.json for agent-to-agent discovery.

skills.name: agent-skills
skills.description: Publish an agent skills discovery index at /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json.

skills.name: oauth-discovery
skills.description: Publish OAuth/OIDC discovery metadata for agent authentication.

skills.name: oauth-protected-resource
skills.description: Publish OAuth Protected Resource Metadata per RFC 9728.

skills.name: auth-md
skills.description: Publish Auth.md agent registration discovery metadata.

skills.name: api-catalog
skills.description: Publish an API catalog per RFC 9727 for automated API discovery.

skills.name: ard
skills.description: Publish an ARD capability manifest at /.well-known/ai-catalog.json so agents can discover your MCP servers, A2A agents, skills and API tools.

skills.name: ucp
skills.description: Enable content payments via Universal Commerce Protocol.

skills.name: x402
skills.description: Support x402 protocol for agent-native HTTP payments.

skills.name: mpp
skills.description: Support MPP (Machine Payment Protocol) for agent-native HTTP payments.

skills.name: webmcp
skills.description: Expose site tools to AI agents via the WebMCP browser API.

skills.name: link-headers
skills.description: Add Link response headers for agent discovery per RFC 8288.

skills.name: dns-aid
skills.description: Publish DNS for AI Discovery (DNS-AID) SVCB/HTTPS records for DNS-based agent discovery.

skills.name: acp
skills.description: Publish an ACP discovery document for agentic commerce.

skills.name: personal-agent-protocol
skills.description: Publish Personal Agent Protocol (Poppy) discovery and validate its OAuth issuer binding.
